title: Lingering blade
wikitext:
'''Lingering blades''' are created by certain [[skills]] and can be detonated with {{il|Blade Blast}} or animated with {{il|Animate Weapon}}. Lingering Blades remain on the ground for a duration and can be used by specific skills. If Animated, they count as Daggers, and have the stats equivalent to a {{il|Glass Shank}}.

The following skills leave lingering blades on the ground:
* {{il|Bladefall}}
* {{il|Bladefall of Trarthus}}
* {{il|Ethereal Knives of Lingering Blades}}

==Modifiers==
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
 mod_stats.id LIKE "%left_in_ground%"
 OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%Lingering%blade%"
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|domain=1
|generation_type=1
}}
